popup.oneLiner: An event-driven serverless Python pipeline that scrapes Google News RSS feeds, synthesizes technical takeaways via Gemini API, and delivers daily morning briefings to Telegram.
popup.problem: Engineers face information overload sifting through scattered news sources and marketing noise. This pipeline automates scraping, filters duplicates, and formats high-signal technical impacts.

workflow.title: Rotating Scraper
workflow.desc: Fetches Google News RSS feeds using an alternating calendar-day topic rotation to prevent feed overlap.

workflow.title: Gemini Synthesis
workflow.desc: Prompts Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite with rigid Markdown layout rules to extract technical impacts and verified sources.

workflow.title: Telegram Dispatch
workflow.desc: Sends formatted digests via Telegram bot with character bounds and URL preview suppression.

highlights: Zero-cost serverless execution running on scheduled GitHub Actions cron runners
Alternating topic rotation keeping daily digests concise and within token budgets
Deterministic RSS preprocessing eliminating marketing fluff before model invocation

popup.oneLiner: LandingVault is a curated web platform and showcase solution aggregating high-converting landing page designs and reusable UI inspiration for others to reference.
popup.problem: Developers and agency founders waste hours searching across disparate sources or building landing page layouts from scratch without proven conversion patterns. LandingVault provides a centralized reference solution.

workflow.title: Browse & Filter
workflow.desc: Explore a categorized reference gallery of hero sections, pricing tables, and feature grids.

workflow.title: Instant Inspect
workflow.desc: View key layout breakdowns, component references, and responsive preview structures.

workflow.title: Reference & Build
workflow.desc: Pull battle-tested conversion patterns and UI ideas directly into your code pipeline.

highlights: Centralized reference solution for modern SaaS landing pages and component patterns
Zero-login instant access to high-resolution conversion UI structures and layouts
Edge Network deployment delivering sub-second page loads for frictionless reference

popup.oneLiner: A real-time website support and technical sales chatbot that crawls documentation, indexes dense vector embeddings, and answers visitor questions grounded strictly in domain data.
popup.problem: Generic chatbots hallucinate pricing and feature details, while rule-based bots frustrate visitors. This RAG architecture enforces strict grounding, eliminating incorrect disclosures.

workflow.title: Ingestion & Chunking
workflow.desc: Crawls site HTML with BeautifulSoup, strips boilerplate scripts and styling, and segments clean text into overlapping windows.

workflow.title: ChromaDB Indexing
workflow.desc: Generates dense sentence embeddings and indexes chunks in ChromaDB for sub-millisecond semantic retrieval.

workflow.title: Grounded Generation
workflow.desc: Injects retrieved top-k context snippets into Gemini with strict boundary prompt engineering.

highlights: Zero-hallucination guardrails instructing the assistant to refuse ungrounded queries
Instant knowledge base updates by modifying vector records without model retraining
Compact 3-to-5 chunk context injection minimizing prompt latency and token usage

popup.oneLiner: A hybrid data engineering pipeline that cleans raw user-uploaded spreadsheets deterministically with pandas, extracts statistical profile metrics, and generates AI executive reports.
popup.problem: Passing multi-thousand-row spreadsheets directly to LLMs wastes thousands of tokens and causes hallucinated numbers. This pipeline executes deterministic cleaning before LLM synthesis.

workflow.title: Sanitization
workflow.desc: Standardizes column headers to snake_case, strips string whitespace, drops empty bounds, and infers strict column types.

workflow.title: Statistical Profiler
workflow.desc: Computes null percentages, unique counts, distributions, and numerical metrics into a compact JSON profile.

workflow.title: AI Synthesis
workflow.desc: Queries Gemini with the low-token summary and 5-row CSV sample to detect anomalies and produce executive insights.

highlights: Slashes token consumption from 20,000+ tokens to under 800 tokens per spreadsheet
100% deterministic type coercion eliminating formatting hallucinations
Automated dual output producing both executive Markdown reports and cleaned Excel files

popup.oneLiner: ToneRD is a developer tool and UI component utility that allows front-end engineers to add instant micro-animations to UI buttons by swapping or adding Tailwind CSS classes.
popup.problem: Adding custom keyframe animations and interactive micro-feedback to UI buttons usually requires writing boilerplate CSS or configuring heavy animation libraries. ToneRD simplifies animations into single, plug-and-play Tailwind utility classes.

workflow.title: NPM Installation
workflow.desc: Developers install the lightweight package into their project via npm install tonerd.

workflow.title: Utility Swap
workflow.desc: Buttons are animated instantly by appending or swapping ToneRD animation classes directly in className.

workflow.title: Interactive Playground
workflow.desc: The web app provides live component previews and copy-paste code snippets for quick integration.

highlights: Zero-friction DX eliminating complex JavaScript animation hooks in favor of class-driven styling
Tailwind native integration slotting into existing design systems without breaking layout structures
Live interactive playground web app for testing and one-click code snippet copying
